scope.description: A factory returning an ordinary object with directly invoked own methods accessor, display and group. Preserve the original object/method identities, accessor function identity without invoking it, fresh spread results and exact pass-through column identities. Accessor inputs are functions or ordinary primitive keys; column definitions are plain enumerable string-keyed own-data objects or nullish. Excludes getters, symbols, reserved prototype keys, extracted method calls and uninstrumented consumers.
